core.headline: Extended 1930s semi-detached house, Oak Lane, Sevenoaks
core.listing:
This four-bedroom semi-detached house in Oak Lane combines original 1930s character with a substantial 2021 rear extension and a 2019 loft conversion with building regulations completion certificate. The property retains its original stained-glass front door and hall window.

The sitting room measures 4.55m x 3.70m into bay (14'11" x 12'2" into bay) and features a log burner. The dining room measures 3.60m x 3.40m (11'10" x 11'2"). The 2021 extension created a kitchen/family room measuring 7.80m x 5.10m max (25'7" x 16'9" max) with an island and bi-fold doors opening to the garden. This space has underfloor heating. A utility room and ground-floor shower room occupy the former garage.

The principal bedroom measures 4.20m x 3.60m (13'9" x 11'10"). Bedroom four, within the loft conversion, measures 5.20m x 3.30m max (17'1" x 10'10" max) and has an en-suite. A family bathroom serves the remaining two bedrooms.

The south-west-facing rear garden extends approximately 30m (100ft) and includes a patio and a garden office with power. A driveway provides parking for two cars.

Sevenoaks station is approximately 0.8 miles away, with trains to London Bridge taking approximately 25 minutes. Sevenoaks School and Knole Park are nearby.

Guide Price £975,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band F (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard – Brick and render under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity, water (metered) and sewerage are mains. Gas central heating; underfloor heating in kitchen/family room. FTTP broadband up to 900Mbps. Good indoor and outdoor mobile signal. The 2021 rear extension was built with planning permission.
